title: Distribution function of ν on (a,b) is nondecreasing and right-continuous (parent Step 2(a),(d))
statement: Let ν be a Borel measure on ℝ and a, b ∈ ℝ with ν((a,b)) < ∞. For r ∈ ℝ let G(r) := ν((a,b) ∩ (−∞, r]), taken as a real number (ENNReal.toReal; the value is finite). Then G is nondecreasing on ℝ. G is also right-continuous at every s ∈ ℝ, i.e. G(r) → G(s) as r → s within [s, ∞) (ContinuousWithinAt G (Ici s) s).
lean_statement: ∀ (ν : Measure ℝ) (a b : ℝ), ν (Ioo a b) ≠ ∞ → Monotone (fun r : ℝ => (ν (Ioo a b ∩ Iic r)).toReal) ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, ContinuousWithinAt (fun r : ℝ => (ν (Ioo a b ∩ Iic r)).toReal) (Ici s) s
